subject: Latency spike: p95/p99 TTFT regressions impacting Cartful production
messages:
From: Nathan Li <nathan.li@cartful.io>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@cartful.io; support@cloudedge.net
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Increased p95/p99 TTFT + 5xx spike for Cartful prod (region us-west-2)

Evelyn —

We started seeing a sharp jump in first-token latency and a correlated 5xx increase around 08:50 PDT this morning on Cartful production. P95 increased from ~220ms to ~1.2s and p99 has spikes above 2.5s. Several user-facing flows time out and our throttling also kicked in.

Attached are a small sample of request IDs (cartful-reqid-logs-20270315.txt) and traces that show long TLS handshake durations and multiple connection retries to edge nodes. Can you confirm whether anything changed on Redwood's side (routing, cert rotation, or CDN config)? This is impacting our checkout flows — we need ETA and mitigation.

Request context:
- Customer: Cartful (us-west-2)
- Time window: 08:48–09:05 PDT
- Error pattern: upstream TLS handshake timeouts, SNI mismatches reported in some traces, intermittent 524/502 from edge

Please loop in engineering and your CDN vendor if needed.

Thanks,
Nathan Li
SRE, Cartful

Attachments: cartful-reqid-logs-20270315.txt (text), traces.zip (referenced)

Nathan — I'll follow up with a status update within 30 minutes. If you see new reqIDs, please append to the file.

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Nathan Li <nathan.li@cartful.io>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:45:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Increased p95/p99 TTFT + 5xx spike for Cartful prod (region us-west-2)

Quick triage notes — posting initial findings.

What I see:
- Grafana: clear jump in TTFT p95/p99 starting 08:49 PDT localized to requests routed through CloudEdge POP group CE-US-WEST-3. Linked dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/abcd/ttft-overview?orgId=1&from=1678830720000&to=1678863600000
- Traces: multiple examples show TLS handshake durations extended (handshake + TCP setup) and repeated client-side retries; a subset show full TLS renegotiation events flagged on the CloudEdge side.
- Control plane: no cert rotations or outbound routing policy changes from our side in the last 48 hours.

Hypothesis: CloudEdge is experiencing an intermittent TLS session negotiation regression on a subset of POPs, causing elevated SYN/TLS times and fallback retries. This manifests as TTFT degradation and client-visible 5xx (gateway/timeouts).

Immediate mitigations attempted:
1) Canary route: we pushed a temporary policy to steer Cartful traffic away from CE-US-WEST-3 to CE-US-WEST-1/2 for a portion of traffic (20%) — seen reduction in p95 for that shard.
2) Short TTL socket cache refresh for affected nodes to avoid reusing potentially bad connections.
3) Opened ticket with CloudEdge support and provided traces/reqIDs (support ticket #CE-65791).

Next steps:
- If CloudEdge confirms a POP-side TLS regression, request they perform a rolling restart/patch.
- If mitigation above holds, prepare a plan to shift 100% traffic for Cartful to alternate POPs until resolved.

Attachments: grafana-ttft-p95-p99-20270315.png

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Sr. SRE, Redwood Inference
Internal: Pager: #oncall-inference

From: CloudEdge Support <support@cloudedge.net>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Cc: Nathan Li <nathan.li@cartful.io>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 10:12:21 -0700
Subject: RE: CE-65791: Investigating TLS negotiation anomaly (CE-US-WEST-3)

Hi Dylan / Evelyn —

Thanks for the data. We've identified an increase in TLS handshake CPU utilization on CE-US-WEST-3 starting 08:46 PDT due to an internal cert cache eviction bug triggered by a specific client hello pattern. We are rolling a hotfix now and performing a rolling restart of the POP to restore normal session negotiation behavior.

Temporary workarounds you can apply:
- Route traffic away from CE-US-WEST-3 (we can coordinate cutover).
- Increase retry backoff on client side to avoid thundering retries while we restart.

We expect the rolling restart to complete in ~25–40 minutes. We'll update ticket CE-65791 in 15 minutes with progress and postmortem link after resolution.

Best,
Aria Mendoza
CloudEdge Operations
support@cloudedge.net

Attachment: cloudedge-pop-logs-snippet.txt (referenced)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Nathan Li <nathan.li@cartful.io>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 10:54:09 -0700
Subject: Re: Customer impact update — Cartful (TTFT & 5xx)

Nathan — thanks for your patience and for the signal. Quick update:

Status:
- CloudEdge has rolled a hotfix to CE-US-WEST-3 and full POP restart completed at ~09:55 PDT.
- We observed TTFT p95 drop from ~1.2s to ~260ms over the next 10 minutes for rerouted traffic; p99 similarly improved.
- We have a mitigation plan to keep Cartful traffic off CE-US-WEST-3 for the rest of the day and will monitor.

Next steps for Cartful:
- We plan a full cutover (100%) to CE-US-WEST-1/2 for your production traffic within the hour; we'll provide a short maintenance window and keep it transparent.
- Engineering (Dylan) will surface a short postmortem when CloudEdge publishes theirs.
- If you require credits, please flag to Evelyn and Marcus and we'll expedite review.

Appreciate the rapid reporting — please reply if you see any regressions.

Sean Gallagher
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com
